targets.title: Functions of the endocrine system
targets.description: 9.a Explain the general functions and physiological roles of the endocrine system.

targets.title: Hormone types and regulation
targets.description: 9.b Differentiate major hormone types and describe how hormonal secretion is regulated.

targets.title: Hypothalamus and pituitary
targets.description: 9.c Describe the functional relationship between the hypothalamus, pituitary gland, and other endocrine organs.

targets.title: Major hormones and their disorders
targets.description: 9.d Explain the actions of major hormones and the consequences of their hypo- and hypersecretion.

targets.title: Endocrine vs. nervous control and stress
targets.description: 9.e Compare endocrine and nervous system regulation of homeostasis, including their coordinated responses to stress.

targets.title: The heart and the pathway of blood
targets.description: 10.a Describe the structure and function of the heart and trace the pathway of blood through the cardiovascular system.

targets.title: Blood vessels and blood flow
targets.description: 10.b Compare the major types of blood vessels and explain mechanisms that regulate blood flow and venous return.

targets.title: Blood composition and clotting
targets.description: 10.c Describe the composition and functions of blood, including formed elements, red blood cell production, hemostasis, and coagulation.

targets.title: Blood typing
targets.description: 10.d Explain the principles of blood typing and transfusion compatibility within the ABO and Rh systems.
